title: Crime Inc.
description:
S1 E4 — Stolen Goods
Criminal networks of thieves break into everything and cash in on a fortune online, at flea markets and on the shelves of stores.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S1 E1 — Illegal Gambling
The multibillion-dollar business of illegal gambling; online wagering; the debate over legalizing gambling.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S2 E4 — Secrets for Sale
A report on corporate espionage is estimated to cost United States companies over $13 billion a year.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S2 E5 — Hollywood Robbery
Inside the high-tech underworld of media piracy: individuals accused of ripping off music, movies and games.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S2 E6 — Medical Insurance Fraud
How the lucrative underworld of health care fraud can put peoples money, health and lives at risk; businessmen who sell phony insurance policies.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S2 E7 — Art for the Taking
Criminals look to make big money in the art world through home invasions, museum thefts and forgeries.

title: Crime Inc.
description:
S1 E5 — Deadly Prescriptions
Rogue pharmacies and strong prescription medicine in the wrong hands cause tragic outcomes; the problem of prescription-drug abuse.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E3 — A Van Full of Dollars
A model bank employee pulls off the second-biggest cash heist in history when he stuffs a work van with $17 million in untraceable cash and flees to Mexico, only to be betrayed by his partners when greed fuels a murder plot.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E4 — The Inside Job
When a violent gang of bank robbers executes a perfect heist, cops don't realize that one of the terrified bank tellers is actually the mastermind behind it all.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E1 — All the President's Money?
The best bank robbers in American history hatch an ingenious plan to steal 30 million from a rumored Nixon slush fund, sparking the biggest FBI manhunt since the Kennedy assassination.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E6 — The Heist of the Century
TV cameras are there when armed bank robbers take hostages at a large, international bank; police don't realize the robbery only masks a more spectacular heist taking place right under their feet.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E2 — Secrets of the Transy Book Heist
Four clean-cut college students risk it all to become super-thieves by targeting $12 million in rare books in a brash daylight heist that baffles the cops hunting them.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E5 — The Picasso Thief
When an irreplaceable Picasso is plucked from a gallery wall, cops know they have just 24 hours to track the thief down before it's likely gone for good.
